publication.title: [v0.93.1] Make prompt interpolation deterministic
publication.body:
Replace randomized repeated interpolation with a single pass over the original template. Preserve literal inserted values, unknown placeholders and role ordering; add focused regressions including cyclic-looking values.

Closes #1288
